scope: Independent source-only review of native SVG capture diagnostics. No browser, build, or tests were launched; no product files were edited.

evidence: The runner exercises both Fast and Deep from a real guest side panel against an owned localhost article, with SVG image load checks, exact path/rect geometry assertions, caption and label checks, and an ordered article sequence.
Deep changes the source caption, bar geometry, and a unique paragraph after Fast, then waits for the changed text before asserting the second capture.
This lane did not launch Chrome or inspect rendered output, so runtime acceptance remains with the owning lane.

changes: The runner now writes bounded failure status, stage, and a structured safe observation, and attempts a panel screenshot when panel exercise fails.
The observation records image load/visibility, caption/label marker presence, and visible error state without saving raw SVG payloads.
evidence: The screenshot is written under the harness-provided artifacts directory (svg-caption-native-acceptance.mjs:215); native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs removes its temporary root recursively in finally after exercisePanel returns or throws (native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs:439-445). The report therefore points at a deleted screenshot after failure.

safeObservation records expectedGeometry for the second image as only a count of three rect elements, not their coordinates; it stores text marker booleans but no order evidence. A geometry or ordering assertion failure consequently leaves insufficient structured state to identify the mismatch (svg-caption-native-acceptance.mjs:155-197).

failure_detail splits the assertion message at the first colon; assertArticle messages start with 'fast:' or 'deep:', so geometry, caption, and ordering failures collapse to only the mode name (svg-caption-native-acceptance.mjs:407-411; assertArticle at 231 onward).

The failure stage remains '*_article_wait' for assertions and settled-state checks that happen after waitFor, so it can misidentify where the failure occurred (svg-caption-native-acceptance.mjs:359-394).
open_questions: The owner should decide whether to repair failure artifact persistence and improve the sanitized snapshot before treating diagnostics as sufficient for runtime failure triage.
